ana: Heads-up: incoming pen-test intake. Need an access vetting playbook for artifact escrow + RBAC rollback corridor. No DB dumps; minimal slices only.
nguyen: I can take the playbook. Key constraints: ephemeral SSO for assessor role, limited to s3:GetObject + kms:Decrypt via a grant, and a recorded rollback corridor for RBAC changes.
cory: Ops note: we'll create per-bundle DEK, wrap with CMK and use EncryptionContext tag pt-id to scope grants. We should KMS-sign the manifest with an asymmetric key so signature verification is auditable.
ana: small edit: call out sanitization step + security sign-off T-30, IP obfuscation to /24, remove emails. Also include an explicit field in manifest: allowed_operations.
ops-bot: Checklist created: manifest fields, presign ttl, grant arn, signer key arn, sanitization sign-off, audit snapshot link.
kms-bot: KMS tip: use create-grant with --constraints EncryptionContextSubset to scope Decrypt. Schedule revoke after TTL. Example revoke automation supported.
nguyen: Retest SLA: 5 business days preferred; escalate to #incidents if remediation introduces privilege expansion. We'll freeze deploys for impacted service until retest passes.
cory: Upload plan: ops will run pt_push.sh which outputs manifest.json + kms-signature, posts presign URL, and schedules grant revoke. I'll run it tonight and post links.
ana: Thanks. Please ack with :white_check_mark: once you own an item.
nguyen: :white_check_mark: playbook owner.
cory: :white_check_mark: uploader.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: revoke grant after presign TTL.
